brief: Attend to the Northcott Bend 230/34kV substation transformer to repair the previously raised gasket repair and fix the fan contactor chattering under load where the cooling stage cycles intermittently [SOP-016]. Run forced cooling continuously through the overnight period rather than allowing the thermostat to drop the stages out [MG-025]. Apply the loading reduction in MG-021 from the third day [MG-021, MG-025].
